title: Enforce Free/Pro/Scale paid plans, server entitlements, period budgets, and Stripe billing

endpoints.before: Gateway admission enforced project minute RPM (120 Free, 1,200 Pro, 6,000 Enterprise) and a shared 100,000/month Free calendar-month quota without server-side plan entitlements or paid billing periods. Unauthenticated requests carrying a configured Origin header bypassed API-key enforcement, while keys holding the `catalog:read` scope bypassed granular scope restrictions. In the rate limiter, ordinary requests could reset active-minute counters for unrelated expensive policies, and origin middleware did not recognize a `scale` tier.
endpoints.after: Commercial plans now define Free (60 RPM when commercial limits are enabled, 100,000 requests per UTC month account-shared), Pro (200 RPM, 300,000 requests per billing period), and Scale (600 RPM, 1,000,000 requests per billing period), while preserving explicit manual and enterprise grants. Entitlements are evaluated server-side before edge-cache reads or quota admission (`403 PLAN_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED`), `5xx` upstream responses credit back consumed period units idempotently, spoofable Origin-header auth bypass and `catalog:read` wildcard bypass are removed in favor of trusted first-party service tokens, and active-minute expensive counters are preserved across mixed requests. Requests are subject to the explicit `search` per-minute expensive policy ceiling for the project's active plan (60/200/600 rpm on Free/Pro/Scale).
endpoints.clientAction: Authenticate with an API key on a plan carrying the required entitlement and handle HTTP 403 (PLAN_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED) and HTTP 429 (PERIOD_QUOTA_EXCEEDED / EXPENSIVE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED) with Retry-After.

In the rate limiter, ordinary requests could reset active-minute counters for unrelated expensive policies, and origin middleware did not recognize a `scale` tier.
endpoints.after: Commercial plans now define Free (60 RPM when commercial limits are enabled, 100,000 requests per UTC month account-shared), Pro (200 RPM, 300,000 requests per billing period), and Scale (600 RPM, 1,000,000 requests per billing period), while preserving explicit manual and enterprise grants. Entitlements are evaluated server-side before edge-cache reads or quota admission (`403 PLAN_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED`), `5xx` upstream responses credit back consumed period units idempotently, spoofable Origin-header auth bypass and `catalog:read` wildcard bypass are removed in favor of trusted first-party service tokens, and active-minute expensive counters are preserved across mixed requests. Requests are subject to the explicit `heavy` per-minute expensive policy ceiling for the project's active plan (20/60/180 rpm on Free/Pro/Scale).
endpoints.clientAction: Authenticate with an API key on a plan carrying the required entitlement and handle HTTP 403 (PLAN_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED) and HTTP 429 (PERIOD_QUOTA_EXCEEDED / EXPENSIVE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED) with Retry-After.

Unauthenticated requests carrying a configured Origin header bypassed API-key enforcement, while keys holding the `catalog:read` scope bypassed granular scope restrictions. In the rate limiter, ordinary requests could reset active-minute counters for unrelated expensive policies, and origin middleware did not recognize a `scale` tier.
endpoints.after: Commercial plans now define Free (60 RPM when commercial limits are enabled, 100,000 requests per UTC month account-shared), Pro (200 RPM, 300,000 requests per billing period), and Scale (600 RPM, 1,000,000 requests per billing period), while preserving explicit manual and enterprise grants. Entitlements are evaluated server-side before edge-cache reads or quota admission (`403 PLAN_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED`), `5xx` upstream responses credit back consumed period units idempotently, spoofable Origin-header auth bypass and `catalog:read` wildcard bypass are removed in favor of trusted first-party service tokens, and active-minute expensive counters are preserved across mixed requests.

endpoints.after: Version 1 gateway now enforces Free (60 RPM when commercial limits are enabled, 100,000/month UTC), Pro (200 RPM, 300,000/billing period), Scale (600 RPM, 1,000,000/billing period), and explicit manual/enterprise grants, returning RFC 9457 Problem JSON `403 PLAN_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED` and `429 PERIOD_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` when exceeded, with idempotent `5xx` period-unit credit-back. Server-owned entitlements are checked prior to edge cache and quota admission, `catalog:read` wildcard bypass is removed, and active-minute expensive counters remain isolated.

endpoints.after: Version 1 gateway now enforces Free (60 RPM when commercial limits are enabled, 100,000/month UTC), Pro (200 RPM, 300,000/billing period), Scale (600 RPM, 1,000,000/billing period), and explicit manual/enterprise grants, returning RFC 9457 Problem JSON `403 PLAN_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED` and `429 PERIOD_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` when exceeded, with idempotent `5xx` period-unit credit-back. Server-owned entitlements are checked prior to edge cache and quota admission, `catalog:read` wildcard bypass is removed, and active-minute expensive counters remain isolated.

Server-owned entitlements are checked prior to edge cache and quota admission, `catalog:read` wildcard bypass is removed, and active-minute expensive counters remain isolated.

endpoints.clientAction: Authenticate with an API key on a plan carrying the required entitlement and handle HTTP 403 (PLAN_ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED) and HTTP 429 (PERIOD_QUOTA_EXCEEDED / EXPENSIVE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED) with Retry-After.

endpoints.before: Version 1 gateway admission enforced Free/Pro/Enterprise RPM and monthly quota without server-side plan entitlement gates, Scale tier support, or paid billing-period allowances. Keys holding the `catalog:read` scope bypassed granular scope restrictions, and ordinary admitted requests could clear active-minute expensive-policy counters in the same window.
